question: The diagonals of three faces of a rectangular parallelepiped that meet at a single corner measure sqrt{5} cm, sqrt{10} cm, and sqrt{13} cm. What is the volume of this parallelepiped?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The sum of the squares of three adjacent face diagonals is twice the sum of the squares of the sides.

⇒ l² + w² + h² = (5 + 10 + 13) ÷ 2 = 14

⇒ Squares of sides: l² = 14 − 10 = 4, w² = 14 − 13 = 1, h² = 14 − 5 = 9

⇒ Sides are l = 2, w = 1, h = 3

⇒ Volume = l × w × h = 2 × 1 × 3 = 6

**∴ The correct answer is 6 cm³.**
